name: Ronald Reagan
hook: The actor-turned-president: 525 electoral votes, "tear down this wall" and the Cold War's last act.

facts.label: the only divorced president
facts.statement: Reagan is the only U.S. president who had been divorced; his first wife was actress Jane Wyman.

facts.label: "Government is not the solution"
facts.statement: A New Deal Democrat in his youth, he declared in his 1981 inaugural address that "government is not the solution to our problem."

facts.label: 525 electoral votes
facts.statement: He beat Walter Mondale in 1984 with 525 electoral votes, the most in U.S. history.

facts.label: "Tear down this wall"
facts.statement: In a June 12, 1987 speech at the Brandenburg Gate, he told Mikhail Gorbachev to "tear down this wall!"

facts.label: Mikhail Gorbachev
facts.statement: His summits with Gorbachev began at Geneva in 1985; the 1986 talks snagged on his "Star Wars" missile-defense plan.

facts.label: Sandra Day O'Connor
facts.statement: In 1981 he appointed Sandra Day O'Connor as the first woman on the Supreme Court.

facts.label: Tampico, Illinois
facts.statement: He was born above a bank in Tampico, Illinois in 1911 and attended Eureka College in the state.
